copiedFrom.note: main-tree commit every file was copied from, byte-identical (git show <commit>:<path>)

archiveCommit: the commit that contains this file; cite it by full SHA, never by branch name

shaKinds.copiedFrom: the main-tree commit the bytes were taken from
shaKinds.introducedBy: the main-tree commit that first added the file
shaKinds.lastChangedBy: the last main-tree commit that changed the file before archival
shaKinds.measuredSource: the source commit the measurement itself recorded, where it recorded one; absent means not recorded

redaction: none: every file is the original committed byte sequence
